purpose: Teach: 吹雪/かぜ/つゆ/ぬき/エスカレーター/キッズ/段差/中高

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、北海道の、本気で、絶対、吹雪、絶対、ニュースで、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見たわよ
lines.en: Aoi, I saw that terrible blizzard in Hokkaido on the news. I was so worried about you.
lines.style: Warm and direct, opening with genuine concern. Bright delivery that softens into tenderness. Steady pace with gentle emphasis on the news detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、かぜ、絶対、ひいたみたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I actually caught a cold from the cold snap up there. It's been rough.
lines.style: A little sheepish, almost amused at herself. Quiet and understated — not looking for sympathy but admitting it. Dry warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、お蕎麦の、絶対、つゆ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: Your soba broth is absolutely perfect. I could have it every day.
lines.style: Genuine praise, not performed. Slow and deliberate, savoring the memory of it. Soft landing on the final word, like she's speaking a small truth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、お砂糖、絶対、ぬき、絶対、で、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、お出しするね、葵で
lines.en: I'll make your coffee without sugar, just the way you like it.
lines.style: Practical and settled, the tone of someone who knows what matters to someone else. Gentle promise underneath. No flourish — just care in the details.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の前の、本気で、絶対、エスカレーター、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、便利と思うわ
lines.en: The escalator in front of your shop is so convenient. I think about that every time I come by.
lines.style: Observant and thoughtful, noticing small kindnesses in the world. Moderate pace, almost meditative. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、キッズ、絶対、向けの、絶対、デザート、絶対、新しく、絶対、考えてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm actually working on some new desserts for the kids who come in. I'm excited about them.
lines.style: Animated and present, energy lifting toward the end. Quick pace with genuine enthusiasm. The openness of someone sharing something she cares about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の入口の、本気で、絶対、段差、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、気をつけてるわ
lines.en: I'm careful about that step at the entrance. I don't want anyone to trip.
lines.style: Quiet attentiveness, the care that doesn't announce itself. Steady and grounded. A note of gentle vigilance, watching out for others.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお客様の中に、本気で、絶対、中高、絶対、生さん、絶対、多いよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A lot of my customers are middle and high school students. It's become a real part of their routine.
lines.style: Warm and quietly proud, noticing the small community she's built. Gentle pace with soft smile beneath the words. Genuine connection in her tone.
